name: Rodea the Sky Soldier
description:
An update is available for Rodea the Sky Soldier.

Update Details:

Adjustments have been made for an improved gaming experience.

Users will need to download the software update prior to using the following online features: Connecting to the Internet through the "Lost Islands" menu.
disclaimer:
The software contents are the same as the packaged version.
Due to the large amount of data, it may take a long time to download the software. Please download while charging your Nintendo 3DS.
